_doc: The homepage map sheet comes in four frames, one per window shape (picked by <picture> media and the same
@media queries in MapTableHome.module.css). Each frame is measured in u = CSS var(--u): the frame is fitted
into the window (contain), so text, folds and printed marks keep fixed positions on the sheet within a frame.
w/h: frame size; ex/ey: felt between the frame edge and the sheet.
heroTop/titleTop/cardsTop: where the headline, the 'פרקי הקורס' title and the card row start (keep in sync
with the CSS). card/gap: the chapter card and the gap between cards; the row is centred.
Folds: the sheet was folded in half across its width, then once lengthwise off-centre. The vertical fold
runs at w/2 + foldXOffset, through the gap between the brand and 'המשך ללמוד'; the horizontal fold at foldY
runs behind the card row (cardsTop + 200), far below 'פרקי הקורס'.
Quiet zones: the print is a real relief with a flat valley floor under the brand row, the headline and the
section title (home_map_table_maps.cjs), so no printed line runs behind them.
